criteria.name: Identity and official footprint
criteria.assessment: The FID 825 source record names Gemini and the reopened lower-floor slab reproduces all 14 official GIS XY vertices within rounding precision. This confirms plan outline only, not elevation or walls above the slab.

criteria.name: Scale and placement
criteria.assessment: The 14-vertex footprint, local metric geometry, and overall plan proportions are consistent. Wall/story and roof elevations are image-based estimates, and the standalone asset does not include the master placement marker, so campus placement and surveyed vertical scale are not established here.

evidence.vertical_dimensions: estimated from current photos; no surveyed elevation

criteria.name: Roof form and height evidence
criteria.assessment: Three separately named roof ranges, two cross-gables, three pitched dormers, and chimneys create a more articulated profile. The current official photo still shows deeper, more legible intersecting gable wings; in the model several roof planes merge into broad shallow bands and the gable/valley relationships are not fully convincing. Roof and chimney elevations remain estimates.

criteria.name: Facade, raised entry, and materials
criteria.assessment: Brick base, pale lap siding, contrasting sash, multiple window rhythms, porch piers, a raised landing, broad stairs, and guardrails address the main photo cues. The entry is clearly elevated and legible. Its porch roof and facade remain schematic compared with the official photo's deep recessed central porch, broad continuous porch railing, and more distinct wing projections; openings are still somewhat regular.

material_names: Gemini | pale concrete entry landing and steps

criteria.name: Interior and portability
criteria.assessment: The fresh-open asset contains a schematic interior rather than an authoritative plan, so room arrangement remains unverified. Portability is strong: all mesh objects have material slots, and no linked libraries or unpacked external image dependencies were found. Geometry is a self-contained standalone collection.

findings: Fresh-opened standalone asset retains the expected scene and exported collection.
GIS ring agreement validates the plan outline, not above-grade wall offsets, facade locations, master placement, or height.
The revised gables, dormers, and porch improve the architectural cues; intersections, facade projection, and roof profiles remain simplified relative to the official exterior.
